equations.label: Son 2017 Eq. (2) maximum opening distance at the transition point (as printed)
equations.quote: transition points can be estimated by Eq
equations.description: Opening distance at which A_min reaches A_cg. The text derives it from Eq. (1) with A_cg in place of A_min, but the printed form has R_post where Eq. (1) has (R_post - t_post); transcribed exactly as printed.
validity: controllable opening range lies below this value

claims.subject: controllable opening range
claims.object: below the transition point, because the transition could cause unexpected instability
claims.statement: From the combustion viewpoint the minimum-area transition could cause unexpected instability, so a controllable range of the opening distance should be considered below the transition point; Eq. (2) estimates the transition opening.
qualifiers: qualitative criterion; no margin fraction stated
claims.quote: distance should be considered below the transition point
